Zoe T: Heads up — Alex (SWE) handed in resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-04-03. Can we align on exit interview timing, benefits/COBRA cutoff, and the access removal window? cc @Linda P
Linda P: Sorry to hear that. Thanks for flagging. Can you drop Alex's email and manager? Any PTO/LOA around the end date?
Zoe T: Alex email is alex.d@redwood.com. Manager is Ben R. No PTO scheduled. US-based, enrolled in medical/dental.
Linda P: OK — plan: 1) I will send COBRA election packet today (state-specific link + vendor info). Benefits typically end on the last day of the month of termination — so coverage runs through 2026-04-30 unless they elect COBRA. 2) I'll propose exit interview slots (30–45m). 3) Payroll: final paycheck + unused vacation payout note — confirm next pay run. 4) IT: request deprovision timing and laptop/asset return process.
Ben R: For handoff: I'll take ownership of the open PRs for now. Suggest 2–3 todo items Alex can jot down in a short doc. If possible, push review of any critical migrations before EOD last day.
IT Ops: We'll do SSO deprovision at EOD on 2026-04-03 (after final sync with manager). For repo/org access we can transfer ownership where needed. Please confirm if any service accounts/keys must remain. Asset return: use this label/return workflow — https://redwood.internal/assets-return :truck: 
Zoe T: Re: service accounts — Alex has a client-facing API key in prod and some SSM entries. We should rotate those before deprovision.
IT Ops: Agreed. Suggested steps (run before 2026-04-03 EOD):
```
# rotate client-facing token
secretsctl rotate --service client-api --user alex.d@redwood.com
# remove SSM parameters owned by alex
aws ssm delete-parameter --name "/staging/alex/secret"
# if you need to preserve keys, create a vault entry and transfer ownership
```
Also, set laptop return ticket: Ticket #IT-7842.
People-Ops-Bot: Exit interview calendar invite created for 2026-04-01 10:00 (30m) — invite sent to alex.d@redwood.com and ben.r@redwood.com :calendar:
Payroll Bot: Final paycheck will be processed on next payroll run (2026-04-10). Any reimbursements or exception items must be in by 2026-04-05 to be included.
Linda P: I'll email Alex the COBRA packet + separation checklist today and open the offboarding form. Can someone confirm the device asset tag and serial?
Zoe T: Device tag is RDW-4421, serial S/N 9X4-ALX. I'll collect a short handoff doc and drop it in the repo under /handovers/alex-d.
Ben R: I'll review the handoff doc and take the open tickets. Please cc me on the COBRA and payroll emails so I can flag any client-impact items.
IT Ops: Noted. We'll hold SSO disable until after Ben confirms no outstanding blocks. After disable we'll run a last audit: `org-audit --user alex.d@redwood.com --export /tmp/alex-audit.json` and attach to the offboarding ticket.
Linda P: Thanks team — I'll mark the offboarding checklist as follows: COBRA packet sent, exit interview scheduled, payroll notified, IT ticket raised, asset return scheduled. Will update status in the offboard tracker.
Zoe T: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll drop the handoff doc and confirm when done. :thumbsup:
People-Ops-Bot: Offboarding form updated: https://redwood.internal/offboard/1978623345 — checklist: 3/5 completed.
Zoe T: Closing loop — handoff doc is in repo, asset ticket updated, and payroll cc'd. Leaving this open for final confirmation once deprovision completes.
Linda P: I'll close once Payroll confirms final pay + COBRA packet acknowledgement.
